🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Positive signs regarding Alejandro Balde, who is currently undergoing medical tests.

The defender reassured a couple of fans that “it’s NOTHING” before entering Ciutat Esportiva. He is already feeling better and will undergo examinations as a precaution. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive
🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Rodri’s moment is coming. Flick hopes he can get some minutes at Riazor, with Atlético up next in a key match for the La Liga title. [@ffpolo] #fcblive
Balde at the Ciutat Esportiva

🚨 | 𝐎𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋: Alejandro Balde has suffered a mild sprain to his right ankle. He has not been ruled out of Sunday's match against RC Deportivo. His availability will depend on how his recovery progresses. #fcblive

📲 | Barça Atlétic player Mirza Ćatović has successfully undergone surgery after suffering a fracture of his left fibula in Barça Atlètic's derby against Espanyol B. He is expected to be sidelined for around four months. A shame because he was one of the best players in the team this season.

Hafiz Gariba and Ebrima Tunkara showed their support for their teammate on Instagram. ❤️

Wishing him a speedy recovery!
Ebrima Tunkara is absolutely unreal 🤯
🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Joan García is on the right track to put his knee swelling behind him. He is working to gradually ease the minor problem in his right knee. [@Jordigil] #fcblive

🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Vincent Kompany has once again ruled out a January departure for Jonathan Tah. Bayern want the defender to stay, despite links with Barcelona. [@FabrizioRomano] #fcblive
🔙 Nobody realized this would be the FINAL piece of silverware he’d ever lift for Barcelona. 🥹

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona are OPEN to selling Jules Koundé if a suitable offer arrives. While a January exit isn't expected, his future will be closely monitored this summer unless his performances significantly improve. [@David_Ornstein] #fcblive
🚨🎖️| Szczęsny is expected to leave Barça when his contract expires at the end of the season. The club sees Dominik Livaković, as Joan García’s long-term backup. [@polballus] #fcblive

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Sources close to Alejandro Balde admit that his severe lack of playing time under Hansi Flick means a departure is now being more closely considered compared to the summer, when he was determined to stay. ​With his contract expiring at the end of next season, Barça sources state no formal offers have arrived yet. [@polballus] #fcblive

🚨🎖️| Barça enquired about 18-year-old left-footed centre-back Ruud Nijstad last summer but deemed FC Twente’s valuation too high. The Dutch defender has started 21 games this season, scoring twice and helping keep five clean sheets. Twente are under no pressure to sell, with his contract running until 2029. [@polballus] #fcblive

🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Marc Bernal is suffering from minor discomfort and will not train today. He is carrying a heavy workload and will miss the session. The plan is for him to train tomorrow and travel for the Deportivo match. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive
